display.purpose: Page titles on Dashboard and Settings.

body.purpose: Default UI copy; kept short by design.

label.purpose: Uppercase section kickers and form field labels.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Default depth cue for nearly every surface; the system's primary signal, not shadow.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Sheets, popovers, and anything genuinely overlaying the page.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft accent-colored halo on hover for interactive elevated surfaces.

motion.name: ease-emphasis
motion.purpose: Sheets and slide-up transitions; more emphatic settle.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's single filled action. Room accent fill, contrasting text, soft accent-tinted glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px); background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-brand-contrast); font-weight: 750; font-size: 0.875rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px var(--primary-glow); transition: transform 120ms ease-out, background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Equal-height sibling to primary; raised surface fill with a hairline border, not a de-emphasized ghost.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text); font-weight: 750; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease-out, border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent, muted text; for tertiary or dismissive actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-weight: 750; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Hairline-bordered raised field with an uppercase tracked label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Elevated Card
components.description: Flat surface with a soft lift; hairline border stays the primary depth cue, shadow is secondary.
components.html:
Racha semanal

4 de 7 días con avance.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl, 16px); padding: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text); } .ds-card__body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); }

components.name: Contribution Cell
components.description: The product's signature element: one grid cell whose fill is color-mixed from that habit's own hex at a level-specific percentage. Shown here at level 3 (excelente) with a sample habit color.
components.css: .ds-cell { width: 56px; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); background: var(--hc); box-shadow: 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--hc) 45%, transparent); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--hc) 20%, #0B0D10); transition: all 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-cell--today { border: 2px solid var(--hc); }

narrative.overview:
Traker never raises its voice. It sits beside you as you start, stall, and come back — never as a coach with a clipboard, never as a dashboard keeping score. The system is calm, quietly premium, and restrained: hairline borders instead of loud dividers, one accent color instead of a palette of alerts, silence as the default state and color as something earned. At the same time it is tactile and native-app in feel — a personal, high-focus tool, closer to a well-made mobile app or Linear than to a corporate admin panel. GitHub's Contributions grid is the closest visual cousin: a compact, silent, personally-colored field of small honest marks, not a chart trying to impress anyone.

The Quiet Companion lives in two rooms, chosen deliberately, not ranked: a daylight room (warm sage-and-cream, :root default, no override needed) and a night room (near-black graphite with a single lime accent, applied via .dark). Neither is the "real" Traker with the other as a fallback — they are the same calm presence at two times of day, switched by the user's theme setting (light / dark / system, defaulting to system). Every component must be authored against the semantic CSS custom properties (--color-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*), never against a literal hex, so it inherits both rooms for free.
keyCharacteristics: Two first-class themes, one semantic token layer — never hardcode a hex that only works in one room.
Hairline borders and flat surfaces at rest; the accent color and glow are earned by state (active, selected, today), not decoration.
The per-habit contribution grid is the emotional center of the product — compact, tactile, personally colored.
Short, human, unhurried copy; density stays low so no screen asks for more than one decision at a time.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each room has exactly one saturated color (Moss Sage or Reactor Lime). It marks primary actions, selection, progress fill, and the "today" ring — never body text, never a decorative fill, never more than roughly one element's worth of attention per screen.

rules.name: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is read from the hairline border first. Shadow is a second-order signal reserved for genuinely floating elements.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Every weight and case variation comes from Inter. Do not introduce a second typeface without updating this file first.

rules.name: The Never-Full-Width Rule
rules.body: Content never stretches edge-to-edge on desktop, even inside a card-heavy page. A generous max-width and centered column are the default, always.

rules.name: The Earned-Glow Rule
rules.body: A visible accent-colored glow is reserved for active, selected, or "today" state — never a resting decoration.

rules.name: The Never-Nested Rule
rules.body: Never place a .card inside another .card's padding — group with spacing and dividers instead.

dos: Do author every color, radius, and shadow against the semantic CSS custom properties (--color-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*) so components work in both rooms automatically.
Do keep the accent color rare — selection, primary action, progress, and the "today" ring only.
Do treat the hairline border as the primary depth cue; reach for shadow only for elements that are genuinely floating above the page.
Do derive any new per-item color logic (tags, categories, areas) the way the contribution grid does: color-mix() against the semantic surface tokens from a single source hex, not a hardcoded palette.
Do keep copy short, calm, and specific — one decision per screen.
donts: Don't hardcode a literal hex or Tailwind gray-*/slate-*/neon-*/cyber-* class in new components — those Tailwind palette extensions are unused legacy.
Don't use red, alarm styling, or urgent motion for routine lateness, a missed day, or a broken streak.
Don't stack a .card inside another .card's padding.
Don't stretch primary content to full width on desktop, even for data-dense screens.

Don't treat --shadow-glow, --color-warning, --radius-cell, --font-mono, .card-interactive, .btn-danger, or .ds-label as reliable styled tokens without checking src/assets/main.css first — none of them are actually declared.
